Twilight Sparkle, Rainbow Dash, Pinkie Pie, Rarity, Fluttershy, and Applejack.

How Mane Six connects

  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — The Mane Six are the standing heroes of Friendship Is Magic.
  • Character: Twilight Sparkle — Twilight Sparkle leads the Mane Six as Celestia's student and later a princess.
  • Character: Rainbow Dash — Rainbow Dash is the loyalty-bearing pegasus of the Mane Six.
  • Character: Pinkie Pie — Pinkie Pie is the laughter-bearing earth pony of the Mane Six.
  • Creator: Rarity — Rarity is the generosity-bearing unicorn of the Mane Six.
  • Character: Fluttershy — Fluttershy is the kindness-bearing pegasus of the Mane Six.
  • Character: Applejack — Applejack is the honesty-bearing earth pony of the Mane Six.
  • Item: Elements of Harmony — The Mane Six wield the Elements of Harmony.
  • Creator: Lauren Faust — Lauren Faust created the Mane Six as adventure-comedy leads.
  • Location: Ponyville — The Mane Six live and work in Ponyville.
  • Character: Nightmare Moon — The Mane Six use the Elements of Harmony against Nightmare Moon.
  • Character: Spike — Spike lives with Twilight and the Mane Six in Ponyville.
  • Character: Discord — The Mane Six first imprison Discord, then befriend him.

What is Mane Six?

The Mane Six are the six ponies at the center of Friendship Is Magic: Twilight Sparkle and her five Ponyville friends, bearers of the Elements of Harmony and the show's standing party.

Key threads lead to My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic, Twilight Sparkle, Rainbow Dash, Pinkie Pie, Rarity and Fluttershy.
